按住筊杯，往上一抛: Hold the moon blocks, then flick up to toss
想问哪件事？比如：这周的面试（可以不写）: What's on your mind? e.g. this week's interview (optional)
默念着它，别松手: Keep thinking about it — don't let go
按住不放，默念三秒: Hold for three seconds while you focus
签在里面翻动，摇到它自己跳出来: The lots are tumbling inside — shake until one jumps out
点一下，签会在里面翻动: Tap and the lots will tumble inside
你 × 今天，只有这一支。同一天里不会变: You × today: this is your one lot. It won't change today.
换个问题，重新摇签: Ask something new and draw again
今天还能换 {n} 次问题: You can change your question {n} more times today
第 {n} 签今天没有求成。明天再来摇一支。: Lot No. {n} wasn't confirmed today. Come back tomorrow and draw again.
还没有抽过签。每天在「今天」里摇一支，都会收在这里。: No lots yet. Draw one each day from Today and it will be kept here.
已经集满一轮。送你一枚御守，在「转运」的「直接买一枚」里免费领。: You've completed the Sixty! An omamori is on us — claim it free under Luck › Buy one.

每一天也有自己的天干地支，60 天一轮。每天打开 flowday，就收下当天的那: Every day has its own pillar, and they cycle every 60 days. Open flowday each day to collect that day's painting; collect all 60 and you get an omamori.
今天这张还没收：回到今天页打开一下就收下了: Today's isn't collected yet — just open Today to collect it
